data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'h-n-y' which means 'to adorn'. Hinaaya means 'graceful' or 'beautiful'. The name Hinaaya carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hinaaya usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
